claim_text: GELU does not cut at zero: a negative input still leaks through, unlike a hard cutoff.

spec.explain: Toy plot from 1606.08415 comparing GELU to a hard cutoff at zero. Watch the gelu number: it dips negative near the minimum and then leaks back toward zero instead of staying at zero.

questions.q: Set x to -1: what happens to the curve? Do you expect GELU to keep falling like ReLU?
questions.why: Tests the leak-through misunderstanding versus the GELU dip and recovery.

questions.q: Set x to -0.75: what happens to gelu?
Set x to -2: what happens to gelu?
questions.why: Reads a far-negative value near zero.

questions.q: Set x to 2: what happens to gelu?
questions.why: Reads a large-positive value near the identity line.
